mygo.appDescription: Your private music collection on the desktop
connectTitle: Bring music back to your desktop.
connectIntro: Enter your server and account once. Pick up where you left off whenever you open the app.
sessionHint: Your password is only used to sign in. The session is saved in your user data directory.
connectionUnavailable: The server is still unavailable. Check your network and try again.
songsIntro: Start with the music you own.
albumsIntro: Revisit your collection one record at a time.
favoritesIntro: Everything you chose to keep close.
noTrayHint: If the system tray is unavailable, closing the window quits the app.
chooseSong: Choose a song from your library
mediaError: The song could not be loaded. Check the server connection or audio format.
invalidServerURL: Enter a full server URL, such as https://music.example.com
serverSchemeRequired: Server address must start with https:// or http://
localHttpRestricted: HTTP is only allowed for an explicitly approved local server; use HTTPS for remote servers
connectFailed: Could not connect to the Lark server
protocolMismatch: The server protocol version is incompatible
linkServerMismatch: This music link belongs to another server. Check its address before signing in.
transportHint: Connect, gRPC-Web or gRPC is selected automatically. Use the same HTTPS address as the web app, including through Cloudflare Tunnel.
connectionSecurity: The app does not store your password.
